Get ready to groove to “Aisi Meri Vibe”, a fresh and energetic track from Vibe! 🎧🔥 Packed with catchy beats, youthful energy, and an irresistible vibe, this song is all about living in the moment and enjoying the rhythm.

Featuring Preity G Zinta, Kunal Kemmu, Sparsh Shrivastava & Vanshika Dhir, the song is sung by Kanfuzion, Khillari & Irfana, with music composed by Kanfuzion and lyrics penned by Khillari & Irfana.
